title: College Attendance: I Will Go Tomorrow

characters.name: Sticky
characters.description: A stickman with a permanently optimistic alarm clock and zero attendance

characters.name: Doodle
characters.description: Sticky's friend, a stickman who actually attends class and suffers for it

scenes.setting: Sticky's bedroom. Alarm clock rings. Sticky is a horizontal stick figure under a blanket.
scenes.action: Sticky slaps the alarm clock. It flies across the room. Doodle appears on phone screen.

dialogue.speaker: Doodle
dialogue.line: Bro, attendance portal says you are at 12 percent.

dialogue.speaker: Sticky
dialogue.line: That is not 0. That is basically a scholarship.

dialogue.speaker: Doodle
dialogue.line: It is basically a warning letter with your name on it.

dialogue.speaker: Sticky
dialogue.line: Relax. I will go tomorrow.

scenes.setting: College corridor. Doodle stands next to a notice board. Sticky appears as a thought bubble.
scenes.action: Doodle points at a notice board. Sticky's thought bubble shows him sleeping with a textbook on his face.

dialogue.speaker: Doodle
dialogue.line: The professor asked where you were.

dialogue.speaker: Sticky
dialogue.line: What did you say?

dialogue.speaker: Doodle
dialogue.line: I said you were sick.

dialogue.speaker: Sticky
dialogue.line: Sick of what?

dialogue.speaker: Doodle
dialogue.line: Sick of waking up before noon.

dialogue.speaker: Sticky
dialogue.line: Accurate. But tomorrow I will be a new man.

scenes.setting: Sticky's room at night. Backpack, books, and shoes are laid out neatly.
scenes.action: Sticky proudly arranges his bag. Then a snack packet appears. Then a video game controller appears. Then a pillow appears.

dialogue.speaker: Sticky
dialogue.line: Bag packed. Shoes ready. Alarm set for 7 a.m.

dialogue.speaker: Doodle
dialogue.line: Wow. You are actually doing it?

dialogue.speaker: Sticky
dialogue.line: I am preparing mentally.

dialogue.speaker: Doodle
dialogue.line: You are eating chips in bed.

dialogue.speaker: Sticky
dialogue.line: Preparation takes many forms.

scenes.setting: Next morning. Same bedroom. Alarm clock rings again.
scenes.action: Sticky extends one stick arm, turns off the alarm, and pulls the blanket over his head. Doodle appears on phone screen, unimpressed.

dialogue.speaker: Doodle
dialogue.line: It is tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: Sticky
dialogue.line: Exactly. And I will go tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: Doodle
dialogue.line: That is today.

dialogue.speaker: Sticky
dialogue.line: Time is a social construct.

dialogue.speaker: Doodle
dialogue.line: Attendance is not.
